🚗 New Free Car Skin
🎉 New Statrer Pack
🏆 Tracks Fixes

🎁Bonus Code "Welcome"

Welcome to Drive it! 🏎️

⚠️ This game is meant for 2 players, make sure you have a friend to play with! ⚠️

Both players must work together to reach your next destination while trying to avoid any TRICKS that they may encounter.
Try not to get sabotaged by other players!

📦 New Update!

🚘Now you won't get stuck on the first track due to a traffic jam!🚘

💾 Checkpoints are saved once reached! 💾
🎁 Join group for a free car 🎁
👾 Feel free to report bugs in the group wall 👾
